deficiencies.description: The rewrite adds that the slice through the tumour 'illustrates this', linking the stained slice directly to the explanting of tumours, which the lecturer did not state.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: often they will explant the tumor. Here you're looking at a slice through a tumor and a stain to look at the morphology.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: A slice through a tumour, with a stain to show the morphology, illustrates this [FIGURE].

considerations.sourcePassage: Primary cells really don't grow in culture.
considerations.reason: 'Really' functions here as a colloquial intensifier rather than a scientific hedge, so omitting it in 'Primary cells do not grow in culture' is an allowed stylistic change.
